title_sq: Tek Kompleksi Dinamo, Shitet Aparatment 2+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Dinamo, ne fillim te Rruges Grigor Heba, shitet apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe neto ne certifikate 64 m/2 , ne katin e pare te nje pallati te ndertuar ne vitin 1988. Apartamenti ka strukture mjaft te rregullt dhe ambjente me hapsira te bollshme. Ai eshte i organizuar ne 1 korridor hyres qe ben ndarjen e ambjentve te tjera. Ne te majte eshte salloni bashke me kendin e gatimit i cili eshte me vete si dhe dhoma matrimoniale, kurse ne krahun e djathte ndodhet dhoma e femijeve e cila ka dalje ne ballkon dhe nje tualet me dritare. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Lindje-Perendim cka ofron nje ndricim natyral shume te mire gjate gjithe dites. Per shkak te vendodhjes ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara te Tiranes dhe faktit qe ndodhet ne katin e pare dhe shume afer me rrugen te jep mundesine per ta pershtatur ne ambjent per biznese te ndryshme. Aktualisht pronari i apartamentit nje pjese te tij e ka pershtatur ne dyqan.
title_en: At Dinamo Complex, 2+1 Apartment For Sale With Ample Spaces!!
description_en: At the Dinamo Complex, at the beginning of Grigor Heba Street, a 2+1 apartment is for sale, with a certified net area of ​​64 m/2, on the first floor of a building built in 1988. The apartment has a very neat structure and spacious rooms. It is organized in 1 entrance corridor that separates the other areas. On the left is the living room with the kitchen corner, which is also the matrimonial room, while on the right side there is the children's room, which has access to the balcony and a bathroom with a window. The orientation of the apartment is South-East-West, which offers very good natural lighting throughout the day. Due to its location in one of the most preferred areas of Tirana and the fact that it is located on the first floor and very close to the road, it gives the opportunity to adapt it to the environment for various businesses. Currently, the owner of the apartment has adapted a part of it into a shop.
